r9.icefall_signal:
In the ice, your team's crystals
show their own colours.
r9.icefall_pool:
The pool under the icefall. Frozen
at the edges, black in the middle.

Something big turns over, far down.
Then nothing.
r9.icefall_pegs:
Old climbing pegs in the ice wall.
Each tag says: "RT SURVEY, 1974".

The newest tag just says:
"please go and look."
r9.icefall_carving:
A crystal cluster, half carved
into the shape of a fish. A big one.

Someone scratched a smile on it.
It does not suit it.
r9.ic.climber_1:
Brenna. I count holds. Four hundred
and twelve on this wall.

You look like four hundred
and thirteen.
r9.ic.climber_1_after:
Four hundred and thirteen.
Fair enough.
r9.ic.climber_2:
Odd. Yes, that's my name.
No, I won't explain it.

Battle me and I'll tell you why.
I won't, actually.
r9.ic.climber_2_after:
My mum just liked the word.
There. Satisfied?
r9.ic.diver:
Sela. I swim under the ice every
morning. It wakes you right up.

Bit cold for small talk.
Let's battle.
r9.ic.diver_after:
Fine. I'm getting back in.
You're not invited.
r9.ic.keeper:
Moss. Somebody has to sweep
the icicles.

Nobody pays me.
I just like it tidy.
r9.ic.keeper_after:
Mind the ledge by the pool.
It only goes one way.
r9.ic.carver:
Pim. I carve what the ice
wants to be.

Today it wants to be a fish.
It always wants to be a fish.
r9.ic.carver_after:
I'll try a goat tomorrow.
It will be a fish.
r9.ic.sledder:
Juno! Fastest sled on the mountain!
Probably! Nobody else races!
r9.ic.sledder_after:
Rematch on the way down.
I'll win that one.
